A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found the equilibrium energy-band diagram and the energy of quantum levels in a p-GaInSb/p-InSb broken-gap heterojunction.
the energy band diagram of a p-GaInASb/p-InAs type-II heterojunction is calculated and the quantum levels are found within the quasi classical approximation.
we have shown that the broken-gap p-type heterojunction is the most promising candidate for the realization of the long-wavelength IR photodetector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the energy of the quantum level is not constant but depends on the applied bias.
the energy-band diagram and the quantum level energies can be controlled by changing the heterointerfacial composition.
the quantum level energies are not only dependent on the heterojunction structure but also on the type of doping in both layers.
